content.title: University of Hawaii at Manoa Academics & Majors - US News Best Colleges
content.text: The student-faculty ratio at University of Hawaii at Manoa is 13:1, and the school has 39.8% of its classes with fewer than 20 students. The most popular majors at University of Hawaii at Manoa include: Psychology, General; Marketing/Marketing Management, General; Registered Nursing/Registered Nurse; Finance, General; Biology/Biological Sciences, General; Exercise Science and Kinesiology; Political Science and Government, General; Speech Communication and Rhetoric; Business Administration and Management, General; and Liberal Arts and Sciences/Liberal Studies.
